carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges run parallel to the shark's axis, characterized by sharp vertical gradients with high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of five small, elongated dark forms (commensal fish) is positioned near the posterior margin of the gill region.
